mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.05% in the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 5.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates a contraction in consumer demand, which lowers corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have declined from prior values, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDP growth >2% and unemployment <5.5%), a month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates robust labor market growth, supporting consumer spending and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased by at least 100,000 in the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units in a month, it signals a significant housing market slowdown that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has fallen below 900.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 have declined from prior values, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5%), a sustained increase in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen above 0.5% in a tightening cycle, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
